description: ADSR envelope generator with a retrigger input, a hold mode for slew limiting and a gate output for each stage

params.text: Sets the attack time, about 3ms at the bottom to about 10 seconds at the top
Sets the decay time, about 3ms at the bottom to about 12 seconds at the top
Sets the level the envelope rests at after the decay, 0-10V, and adds a positive offset to the slewed voltage in HOLD mode
Sets the release time, about 3ms at the bottom to about 12 seconds at the top
Fires an envelope by hand, and lights in step with the contour being generated
HOLD stalls the envelope at its sustain level and turns the module into a slew limiter; GATE runs every stage while the gate is high; TRIG completes the attack and then goes straight to the release
Morphs the contour from linear anticlockwise to a logarithmic attack with exponential decay and release clockwise

inputs.text: Shifts that stage's time, summed with its slider; negative voltage brings the shortest time down to about 0.8ms
Shifts the sustain level, -10V to 10V summed with the slider, and is the voltage that gets slewed in HOLD mode
A rising edge restarts the attack stage from the level the envelope has reached
A gate or trigger starts the envelope

outputs.text: The envelope, 0-10V, or the slewed input at -10V to 10V in HOLD mode
A 10V trigger at the start of every envelope stage
A 10V gate held for the length of that stage, and in HOLD mode for the length of the matching slew
